_about: Airbus AC A319 (Jul 01/26), 2-2-0, Sharklet sheet 4 (page index 44): layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill at scale 20 with --xscale 1.0249, clip 145,215,470,515 (plan, the upper half; centerline y 3064). The A320's points moved by the shorter fuselage onto this sheet, then snapped. Groups then laid on this sheet by their best fit lengthwise (fin -78 px, engine +58, sharklet +128; plan: wing +92, tailplane -12): the A319 sheet places them a little differently from the plugs alone.
